Instrument.name: MIMI Charge/Energy Mass Spectrometer for Cassini Orbiter
Instrument.description: The MIMI Charge/Energy Mass Spectrometer for Cassini Orbiter measures the charge, energy, and mass of particles in Saturn's magnetosphere. It plays a critical role in studying the composition of charged particles and their interactions within the magnetosphere, providing insights into the planet's magnetic environment.
